subtitle: Veza isithombe esifihliwe
short_description: Sebenzisa izimpawu zemigqa namakholomu ukuveza isithombe esifihliwe se-5×5.
description:
Gcwalisa igridi ye-5×5 ukuze umugqa ngamunye nekholomu ngayinye ihambisane nezimpawu zayo zokuqhubeka: inombolo ngayinye ingumugqa wamaseli agcwele ahlanganayo, futhi amabhloko ahlukaniswe yiseli elingenalutho elilodwa noma ngaphezulu. Ibhodi ngayinye iwumklamo omncane wamapikseli.

Thepha iseli ukuze uligcwalise, thepha futhi ukuze uliqamule, bese uthepha okwesithathu ukuze usule. Zonke izimpawu zemigqa eyishumi zihlala zibonakala.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
